Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly concluded that Allan Kroeker’s birthplace was Vancouver, BC based on search snippets and did not verify by opening sources. This contradicted the visible Wikipedia snippet on the same results page stating Winnipeg, Manitoba. The error stemmed from over-reliance on unverified snippets and failure to cross-check with authoritative sources before asserting a birthplace.
